description: Star, search, and reuse structured prompts from thread, project, or all history.
overview:
Keep useful prompts close at hand. Search the current thread, a project, or all visible thread history, star prompts, and restore them into the composer.

Restoring a prompt preserves its structured text and attachment references. Uploaded attachments reused in another project are copied into that project's storage before sending. Machine-local attachments must belong to the destination machine.

Prompt Library is optional and is not installed automatically. Starred prompts are stored locally in the plugin's storage.
